function doSearch(searchData) {
    var query = $("#search").val();
    $("#search").removeAttr("aria-activedescendant");
    
    if ($("#search").val().length >= 2) {

        //Case insensitive search and return matches to build the  array
        var results = $.grep(searchData, function (item) {
            return item.search(RegExp(query, "i")) != -1;

        });

        if (results.length >= 1) {
            $("#res").remove();
            $('#announce').empty();
            $(".autocomplete-suggestions").show();
            $(".autocomplete-suggestions").append('<ul id="res" role="listbox" tabindex="-1"></ul>');
            counter = 1;
        }

        //Bind click event to list elements in results
        $("#res").on("click", "li", function () {
            $("#search").val($(this).text());
            $("#res").remove();
            $('#announce').empty();
            $(".autocomplete-suggestions").hide();
            counter = 1;

        });

        //Add results to the list
        for (term in results) {

            if (counter <= 20) {
                $("#res").append("<li role='option' tabindex='-1' class='autocomplete-suggestion' id='suggestion-" + counter + "'>" + results[term] + "</li>");
                counter = counter + 1;
            }

        }
        var number = $("#res").children('[role="option"]').length
        if (number >= 1) {
            $("#announce").text(+number + " suggestions found" + ", to navigate use up and down arrows");
        }

    } else {
        $("#res").remove();
        $('#announce').empty();
        $(".autocomplete-suggestions").hide();
    }

}

function doKeypress(keys, event) {
    var highligted = false;
    highligted = $('#res').children('li').hasClass('highligt');
    switch (event.which) {

        case keys.ESC:
        case keys.TAB:
            $("#search").removeAttr("aria-activedescendant");
            $("#res").remove();
            $('#announce').empty();
            $(".autocomplete-suggestions").hide();
            break;

        case keys.RIGHT:
            selectOption(highligted);
            break;

        case keys.RETURN:
            if (highligted) {
                event.preventDefault();
                event.stopPropagation();
                selectOption(highligted);
            }
            break;

        case keys.UP:
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopPropagation();
            moveUp(highligted);
            break;

        case keys.DOWN:
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopPropagation();
            moveDown(highligted);
            break;

        default:
            return;
    }
}

function moveUp(highligted) {
    var current;
    $("#search").removeAttr("aria-activedescendant");
    if (highligted) {
        console.log("Highlighted - " + highligted + "");
        current = $('.highligt');
        current.attr('aria-selected', false);
        current.removeClass('highligt').prev('li').addClass('highligt');
        current.prev('li').attr('aria-selected', true);
        $("#search").attr("aria-activedescendant", current.prev('li').attr('id'));
        highligted = false;
    } else {

        //Go back to the bottom of the list

        current = $("#res").children().last('li');
        current.addClass('highligt');
        current.attr('aria-selected', true);
        $("#search").attr("aria-activedescendant", current.attr('id'));
    }
}

function moveDown(highligted) {

    var current;

    }
}
